name: Corded hedge trimmer, 500W
description: 500W hedge trimmer with 55cm double-sided blades. Cuts privet, box and laurel cleanly. 10m cable included. The guard is scuffed but the blades were sharpened last season.

name: Petrol lawn mower, 46cm cut
description: Four-stroke petrol mower with a 46cm deck and a 60-litre grass box. Mulching plug included. Starts on the second pull when cold. Best for medium lawns; the rear roller makes stripes.

name: Cordless grass strimmer
description: Battery strimmer with 30 minutes of runtime per charge and a spare battery. Trims edges, fences and around planters. The spool is easy to refill. Comes with two 2.0Ah batteries and a charger.

name: Electric leaf blower
description: Blows leaves, grass clippings and sawdust off paths and driveways. Variable speed and a vacuum mode with a collection bag. Light enough to use one-handed. Cable is 8m.

name: Petrol chainsaw, 40cm bar
description: 45cc petrol chainsaw with a 40cm bar for logs, storm damage and clearing scrub. One spare chain and a sharpening file included. Starts reliably; the bar oil reservoir needs topping up each use.

name: Electric pressure washer, 130 bar
description: Cold-water pressure washer for patios, driveways, bikes and garden furniture. 130 bar with three nozzles and a 6m hose. The trigger gun drips slightly when released; a new O-ring is included.

name: Galvanised wheelbarrow
description: Steel wheelbarrow with a 65-litre tray and a pneumatic tyre. Hauls soil, compost, gravel and garden waste. The tyre holds air; the tray has one small dent that does not affect use.

name: Garden tool set with border spade
description: Border spade, fork, weed fork and hand trowel with ash handles. Used for planting, edging and turning compost. Cleaned and oiled after each use. The spade edge is sharp — please handle carefully.

name: Bypass secateurs and loppers
description: Bypass secateurs plus long-handled loppers for branches up to 40mm. Both have been cleaned and oiled. The secateurs spring is new; the loppers have a slightly loose pivot that you can tighten by hand.

name: 30m garden hose reel
description: Wall-mounted reel with 30m of reinforced hose, a spray gun and connectors. Fits a standard outdoor tap. The reel swivels smoothly; one connector has been replaced with a brass one.

name: Mini rotavator, petrol
description: Petrol cultivator for breaking up beds, mixing compost and weeding between rows. Starts easily and digs to about 20cm. Foldable handles fit in a car boot. Please use it on dry soil.

name: Telescopic pole pruner
description: Reaches branches up to 4m without a ladder. Telescopic aluminium pole with a bypass cutting head and a pruning saw. The rope and pulley work smoothly. Ideal for fruit trees and hedges.

name: 5.5L stand mixer with bowl
description: Planetary stand mixer with a 5.5-litre bowl, dough hook, whisk and paddle. Kneads bread, creams butter and whips cream without strain. The slow speed is quiet; the head tilt lock is firm.

name: 11-cup food processor
description: Food processor with an 11-cup bowl, chopping blade, dough blade and three discs for slicing and grating. Great for pesto, hummus, pastry and coleslaw. The lid interlock works reliably.

name: High-speed blender, 1.8L
description: 1200W blender that crushes ice, frozen fruit and nuts for smoothies, soups and sauces. Two 1.8-litre jugs included (one with a travel lid). The base is stable and the blades are sharp.

name: 5.8L air fryer
description: Large air fryer with eight presets for chips, chicken, fish and vegetables. Uses far less oil than a fryer and heats up in three minutes. The basket is non-stick and washes easily.

name: Bean-to-cup espresso machine
description: Grinds beans and pulls espresso at the touch of a button, with a steam wand for milk. Includes a tamper and two portafilter baskets. Descaled last month. Please bring your own beans.

name: 6L slow cooker
description: Six-litre slow cooker with low, high and keep-warm settings. Feeds six comfortably — stews, curries, pulled pork and overnight porridge. The ceramic pot and glass lid are both intact.

name: Bread maker with gluten-free cycle
description: Programmable bread maker with 12 cycles including gluten-free, dough and jam. Makes a 1kg loaf overnight. The paddle and measuring cup are included. The non-stick pan is scratch-free.

name: Stainless pasta machine
description: Hand-crank roller for fresh tagliatelle, ravioli and lasagne sheets. Nine thickness settings and a clamp that fits most worktops. Includes a drying rack and a cutter attachment.

name: Ice cream maker, 1.5L
description: Freezer-bowl ice cream maker for gelato, sorbet and frozen yoghurt. The bowl needs 12 hours in a freezer first. Includes a recipe booklet and a spare paddle. Works best with chilled mix.

name: Belgian waffle maker
description: Deep-pocket waffle iron with non-stick plates and a browning dial. Makes two thick Belgian waffles at a time. The plates wipe clean and the indicator light works. Great for weekend brunch.

name: 9-tray food dehydrator
description: Nine-tray dehydrator for dried fruit, jerky, herbs and vegetable crisps. Adjustable thermostat from 35 to 70 degrees and a timer. Trays are dishwasher-safe. Used for two seasons.

name: Sous-vide circulator
description: Immersion circulator that holds water within 0.1 degrees, for steak, chicken and vegetables. Clamps onto any pot. Includes a vacuum-sealed starter bag set. App pairing works but is optional.

name: Cold-press juicer
description: Slow masticating juicer for leafy greens, carrots, apples and ginger. Produces dry pulp and clear juice with minimal foam. All removable parts have been washed. The feed chute is 75mm.
